game_title: Strip And Replace – Avalanche Slope Rush
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Avalanche Slope, a slope primed for avalanche: the rescue climber must handle ice hawks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Strip And Replace: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it.
theme: Frost Peaks – Avalanche Slope: a slope primed for avalanche
core_gameplay_loop: In Avalanche Slope, repeat each round: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it. Each round, a new ice axes challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the clean_text value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 340 points of ice axes by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 340, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 7 (applied tier): Strip And Replace
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Strip And Replace' (Week 8 slot 14), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Avalanche Slope'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clean_text changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice hawks in Avalanche Slope.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 340 within 48 seconds.
